[[File:Security_kit.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A security kit]]
A '''security kit'''<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> or '''security bypass kit'''<ref name="SD">{{JournalCite|5|Stand and Deliver}}</ref> was a collection of tools and electronic components designed specifically for bypassing [[Electronic lock|electronic]] and [[Mechanical lock|mechanical]] [[Lock/Legends|locks]]. [[Sensor/Legends|Sensor]] devices were often included as part of the kit to aid in their use. These items were highly restricted on most worlds and possession was only permitted by those with proper permits, like members of law enforcement or professional security experts.<ref name="RPG-Core" />

[[File:Star_Wars_RPG_Security_Kit.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Security kit interior]]
Deluxe security kit models contained a dedicated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to monitor frequencies typically used by silent alarms to warn the user of detection. Security kits could weight between 1 and 1.2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] depending on the design. The kits usually retailed for five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a standard kit, and up to one thousands credits for a deluxe kit.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
